The data sets of this vignette are simulated maize trials shipped with the
package.

## Genotype x environment interaction: AMMI

Twelve hybrids in six environments with three blocks each:

```{r}
am <- ammi(maize_met, "Yield_t_ha", "Hybrid", "Environment", block = "Block")
am
```

The AMMI2 biplot shows which hybrids interact with which environments; points
near the origin are stable:

```{r}
plot(am, type = "ammi2")
```

## Stability

`stability()` gathers the classical stability statistics: Eberhart and
Russell's regression, Finlay and Wilkinson, Shukla's stability variance,
Wricke's ecovalence, Kang's yield-stability statistic and Huehn's
nonparametric measures.

```{r}
st <- stability(maize_met, "Yield_t_ha", "Hybrid", "Environment", block = "Block")
st
```

## Line x tester

```{r}
lt <- line_tester(maize_lxt, "Yield_t_ha", "Line", "Tester", block = "Block")
lt
```

## Diallel crosses

Griffing's four methods (with or without parents and reciprocals), with the
general and specific combining abilities and their standard errors:

```{r}
dl <- diallel(maize_diallel, "Yield_t_ha", "Female", "Male", block = "Block", method = 4)
dl
```

## North Carolina designs

Designs I, II and III estimate the additive and dominance variances from the
analysis of variance of the progenies:

```{r}
nc_design(nc_designs$nc2, "Yield_t_ha", "Male", "Female", block = "Rep", set = "Set", design = 2)
```
